He shared touching memories of playing Antakshari with a companion in the hospital's waiting area, desperate for news. Even after achieving great success, the regret of not being able to save his father haunts him, revealing the personal struggles he endured at the onset of his acting career.

title: Rajinikanth says he wanted Tamannaah Bhatia to do a song in 'Jailer 2'
description: At a recent event, Rajinikanth revealed his wish to have Tamannaah Bhatia to join the cast in a song for 'Jailer 2'. He relayed his suggestion to director Nelson Dilipkumar, who remained somewhat reluctant. Rajinikanth pointed out that audience satisfaction takes precedence over personal opinions. Continuing the plot, the sequel showcases the retired jailer confronting a fresh wave of crime.

title: Himesh Reshammiya wishes Bachchan on 84th birthday: 'Biggest superstar'

title: Hema Malini wishes Rekha on her 72nd birthday, shares unseen pictures with the actress
description: Veteran superstar and politician Hema Malini extended warm birthday wishes to her longtime friend and fellow actor Rekha, who turned 72 on Saturday.

title: When Bachchan slammed rumours of Rekha moving in with him
description: Amitabh Bachchan has long been vocal about dispelling rumors linking him romantically to Rekha. In several interviews, he stressed that their relationship is purely professional, criticizing sensational tabloid narratives that imply otherwise. Meanwhile, Rekha has openly confessed her admiration for him in different media, shedding light on the complicated dynamics of their public personas and the misinterpretations that often cloud their history.

title: Nushrratt's FIRST post after Bali spine injury: 'Picture abhi baaki hai'
description: After suffering a spine injury in Bali, Nushrratt Bharuccha turned to Instagram to share her recovery journey. Despite the obstacles she faces, she remains optimistic about healing. Her publicist has disclosed that she underwent surgery to address the injury and is prioritizing her health during this time. As a result, the actress's scheduled work has been postponed, though more information on her recovery will be shared in the near future.

title: Shriya Saran recalls she left cousin’s wedding for 'RRR' audition
description: Shriya Saran was at her cousin's wedding when an exciting opportunity knocked: an audition for 'RRR'. Lacking sleep from the festivities, she hurried to catch a flight to Hyderabad. As soon as she arrived, the team eagerly got her reading the script and shooting. She looks back fondly on the strong bonds formed on set, with shared lunches becoming a daily ritual.

title: Shakun Batra explains why Bollywood romances fail to connect with Gen Z
description: Filmmaker Shakun Batra delves into the difficulties faced by Indian romantic films in appealing to today's youth. He stresses the need for authentic storytelling over trend-following. Batra points out that Bollywood's often exaggerated representation of romance does not resonate with younger viewers. He encourages filmmakers to convey real emotions, bridging the gap between narratives and audience expectations, believing that adaptive storytelling is vital for continued success.

title: Imran Khan DETAINED by Mumbai Police at during protest
description: In Mumbai, Imran Khan was detained by police for protesting without the required permits, joining a wave of dissent against alleged electoral misconduct. Meanwhile, in Delhi, authorities detained around 1,500 individuals, including prominent figures, ahead of a planned protest. Demonstrators are calling for the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, as previous protests highlighted student support against police actions and concerns over electoral integrity persist.

title: Sanjay Dutt recalls 1993 incident of keeping weapons in his house
description: During a reflective talk, Sanjay Dutt revisited the painful memory of his arrest in 1993 for possessing illegal firearms. He pointed out how vital it is to heed one's instincts and grasp the intricacies of the law. A touching memory arose when he recounted being handcuffed before his father, renowned actor Sunil Dutt, who was visibly distressed.

title: Anil shares throwback: director recalls Nana Patekar’s warmth
description: Shooting ‘Arjun Naga’ has brought back fond memories of Nana Patekar for filmmaker Anil Sharma. Sharing a throwback video from their ‘Vanvaas’ days, showing Patekar gently combing his hair, Sharma wrote that he misses the veteran actor and his affection. Patekar, known for ‘Parinda’ and ‘Krantiveer’, died on October 8.

title: ' Drishyam 3 The Conclusion' zooms past Rs 446 crore worldwide gross on Day 9
description: Ajay Devgn’s crime thriller has entered its second weekend after crossing Rs. 400 crore in worldwide gross collections on Day 8. Following a Rs. 245.50 crore India net collection in its opening week, the film earned Rs. 14.50 crore on Day 8, taking its domestic net total to Rs. 260 crore. With Day 9 live collections. Two targets now stand out: Rs 300 crore India net, which needs about Rs 36.42 crore more, and a worldwide gross of Rs 415 to 420 crore.

title: Kunal Kapoor criticises Elon Musk over Starlink’s India entry row
description: Kunal Kapoor raised alarms over Elon Musk's dismissive stance towards regulatory challenges facing Starlink in India. He noted parallels with Musk's previous controversies in Thailand and Brazil, emphasizing the expectation that nations should embrace him as a remedy for their issues. In contrast, the Indian government defended its structured approval process for satellite communications, pointing to underlying themes of colonial attitudes prevalent among influential foreign tycoons.

title: Subhash Ghai praises Ranbir Kapoor and backs Nitesh Tiwari Ramayana
description: Subhash Ghai has backed Nitesh Tiwari’s ‘Ramayana’, saying he expects a lot from the film and praising its director, storytelling and cast, including Ranbir Kapoor. Speaking at India Today Conclave Mumbai 2026 on October 10, Ghai said AI may transform filmmaking but cannot replace a good storyteller or alter the emotions at the heart of an epic. His daughter, Meghana Ghai Puri, also reflected on the challenges and responsibility of carrying forward his legacy.

title: ‘Jailer 2’ ticket prices hiked in Andhra Pradesh for opening week
description: Rajinikanth's upcoming film 'Jailer 2' will release in theatres on October 15. The Andhra Pradesh government has approved a ticket price increase for the film's opening week. Single-screen theatres can charge an additional Rs 50, while multiplexes can add Rs 75. The increased rates will apply for seven days, covering five shows daily. In contrast, Vijay Deverakonda's 'Ranabaali' will release at regular ticket prices in Andhra Pradesh.

title: Adhure Hum Adhure Tum: Imran races to finish OTT comeback
description: Imran Khan’s comeback film ‘Adhure Hum Adhure Tum’, co-starring Bhumi Pednekkar, is reportedly targeting a December 18 release. The team is racing to finish post-production, Imran told Hindustan Times. It marks his first lead role since ‘Katti Batti’ (2015), following a cameo in ‘Happy Patel: Khatarnak Jasoos’ earlier this year.

title: Madhuri shares funny shoot memory of director crying on the trolley during a scene
description: Madhuri Dixit shared a humorous anecdote about a director who often let his emotions spill over on set, shedding tears during pivotal scenes. During a particularly tender moment, she noticed him sobbing on a trolley, which prompted laughter from Sonali Bendre, present as a guest. Reflecting on this, Madhuri appreciated the director's deep passion and discussed their unique collaboration while promoting her new venture on 'Kon Honar Crorepati'.

title: Saba Pataudi recalls feeling HURT by sister Soha during brain tumour surgery
description: At just 27 years old, Saba Pataudi bravely shared her journey with a benign brain tumour. During her recovery, she expressed her dismay over limited support from her sister, Soha. The emotional struggle was palpable, as she feared becoming reliant on others. However, her family, including mother Sharmila Tagore and brother Saif Ali Khan, rallied behind her, showcasing the intricate dynamics of sibling bonds in tough times.
